_comment: PLACEHOLDER local amounts: founder to confirm. Every page reads prices from this file. English headline price is US$9.99 a month. Cantonese shows HK$78 (what checkout charges today) with USD highlighted; other languages show US$9.99 only until a local amount is set ('main' as a string, shown with the USD price highlighted). checkout_matches=false means checkout still charges Hong Kong dollars (HK$78): the note 'charged in Hong Kong dollars (HK$78) for now' is shown on non-Cantonese pages only while this is false. show_hkd_note_on lists where the Hong Kong dollar note may appear while checkout_matches is false: the subscriptions page (marked <!--hkd-->...<!--/hkd--> in content/legal/subscriptions.html) and the Cantonese page. Everywhere else prices read US$ only. Once checkout_matches is true the note disappears from both.
